collection.description: A rare forest bird is hunted because villagers believe its feather wards off misfortune.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A rare forest bird is hunted because villagers believe its feather wards off misfortune.

choices.label: Permit limited gathering of naturally shed feathers.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The bird population appears to recover over several seasons.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some families feel a cherished custom has been dismissed.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The ceremony continues without killing birds.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Feathers remain scarce, prompting new designs.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A scientist finds no reliable evidence for the feather's power.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Believers maintain the symbol has value beyond measurable effects.
